D/LG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wvw.'.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 119 s. 2022 October 10, 2022 DIRECTOR PAIZAL O. ABUTAZIL Regional Director, DILG-RegionaI Office IX President Corazon C. Aquino Regional Government Center Balintawak, Pagadian City Dear RD Abutazil: This has reference to your 2nd Indorsement dated 24 August 2022 requesting for further indorsement to the Office of the President a copy of petition from the Panlalawigang Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) of the Province of Zamboanga Del Sur for "Recall and Disqualification Against the Incumbent Sangquniang Kabataan Panlalawigan Pederasyon President Hon. Virgil B. Pillar on the Ground of Loss of Trust and Confident and His Moral Ascendancy to Lead the Federation". Foremost, we ought to remind your good Office that as of June 15, 2021 the Department has already implemented the National Quality Management System (NQMS). Based on the approved Quality Procedure (QP) for Rendition of Legal Opinion, if the letter-sender opts to submit his/her letter-query to the Regional Office, the Regional Legal Officer has to take the following course/s of action as may be warranted under the circumstances: a) If the Legal Officer finds the letter-query/request and attachments sufficient to come up with a comprehensive draft and the issues proffered were already subject of an existing opinion rendered by the Central Office, he/she shall proceed with the preparation of the initial draft. If the letter-query/request for legal opinion lacks attachments/or has incomplete details, draft a letter to the sender requesting for submission of complete attachments or filling-up of the lacking details, b) If the issues proffered in the letter-query/request for legal opinion involve novel issue/s, draft an Indorsement with initial position on the matter to the LLLS, Central office for final disposition pursuant to DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2010-01. c) If the subject of the letter-query/request for legal opinion involves issues subject of pending litigation or with other NGA or government/justiciable controversy, draft a letter-reply to the sender citing the appropriate reason why no LO can be issued pursuant to DILG CO Memorandum Order No. 2010-02. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

It appears that paragraph (c) as afore quoted should be observed. Moreover, it must be noted that the governing issuance regarding this matter (DILG-COMELEC-NYC JMC No. 2017-01) was disseminated to all Regional Offices. Thus, a more prudent examination of the issues raised in the subject petition would have led to an ascertainment that the issues therein submitted can be unmistakably addressed by referring to the said JMC 2017-01. Be that as it may, in the interest of time, JMC 2017-01 provides the guidelines on the conduct of Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Pederasyon Election, as well as rules governing terms of office, suspension and removal of all SK Pederasyon officers. Section 31 (a) thereof states: "SECTION 31. GROUNDS FOR DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS a. Any SK Pederasyon Officer may be disciplines, suspended, or removed from office, after due notice and hearing on any of the following grounds: 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. Abuse of authority Commission of any offense involving moral turpitude or an offense punishable by at least prision mayor (6 years and 1 day to 12 years imprisonment; Failure to perform official duties and functions as Pederasyon Officer, Commission of any violations cited in the respective IRP of the concerned Pederasyon; and Such other grounds as may be provided under the Local Govemment Code of 1991, this JMC and all other applicable general and special laws. " Furthermore, Section 32 of the same JMC provided for the rules on the form and filing of complaints, to wit: "SECTION 32. FORM AND FILING OF COMPLAINTS - A verified complaint against any Pederasyon Officer shall be initiated only by any officer or member of the concemed Pederasyon and shall be filed before the following: a. Office of the President, in the case of the Panlalawigan, Panlungsod/Bayan Pederasyon Presidents who are ex-officio members of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, Panlungsod (HUC, ICC or Component City and the Pederasyon President of Pateros NCR, respectively; or b. Sangguniang Panlalawigan in the case of the Pambayang Pederasyon President who is an officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan (municipality), whose decision may be appealed to the Office of the President; or c. Sanggunian concemed in the case of other officers of the concemed Pederasyon, whose decision shall be final and executory. Page 2 of 3

Therefore, since Mr. Vergel P. Pillar is the incumbent President of the SK Pederasyon of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur, in accordance with Section 32(a) of the JMC, the complainants in this case, should have filed their verified complaint DIRECTLY before the Office of the President (OP), and in our view, should not be coursed through to the DILG Secretary. The Region, with all due respect, should have advised the concerned SK Pederasyon on this matter. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. J Unde OUS L.NJV I R R. LLAMAS r tary for External, Legal and Legislative Affair ULLLS-LRALLD/jvpr
